tasks.title: Replace the 'What this project is' sections in AGENTS.md and MEMORY.md with your project
acceptance: AGENTS.md 'What this project is' section describes the real project in 3-6 lines (template placeholder text removed)
.agents/memory/MEMORY.md 'What this project is' and 'Current phase' sections describe the real project

tasks.title: Run ./scripts/agentic init with your project name, preset, and owner, and commit the result
acceptance: approvals.yaml owner field names the real owner and .github/CODEOWNERS was regenerated to match
./scripts/agentic gates passes with the preset's gate bindings
init output is committed in a single commit

tasks.title: Write your first feature spec from .agents/specs/TEMPLATE.md and generate tasks with the plan-feature skill
acceptance: A spec exists at .agents/specs/<feature>.md following TEMPLATE.md (Problem, Outcome, Non-goals, Acceptance criteria, Open questions; one page or less)
The spec was reviewed by a human before task generation
Tasks were added via ./scripts/agentic tasks add with concrete acceptance criteria and --spec references, and ./scripts/agentic tasks validate passes
